en: A monochrome postcard showing an exhibition ground with long pavilions, a small octagonal kiosk with a tall pointed roof in the foreground, rows of empty chairs along wide avenues, a few people standing, and hills in the background. The printed caption in Hungarian at the top right mentions the Pécs national exhibition and its machine hall and ceremonial hall. The reverse side is a classic divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text indicating 'postcard', a circular stamp dated 1907 referring to the same exhibition, and a photographer's credit at the bottom.
